title: Applicant intake
description: The facts an applicant can supply about themselves. This is the intake contract: the set of fields the assessment engine can ask about, the type of each answer, and the closed value vocabulary where one exists. Every field is optional - a field that was not supplied stays missing (UNKNOWN), which is deliberately different from a field that was supplied and fails (FAIL).

visa.description: The visa program being applied for. Required.

program_id.description: The immigration program id, e.g. SKILLED_189, SKILLED_190, SKILLED_491.

age.description: Age in years at the time of application.

has_regional_nomination.description: Whether the applicant holds a regional nomination.

visa_subclass.description: The subclass code being applied for, e.g. 189, 190, 476.

visa_history.description: The applicant's prior Australian visa history. NONE means no prior application; PRIOR_GRANTED means a visa was granted; PRIOR_REFUSED / PRIOR_CANCELLED / PRIOR_REMOVED record how a prior application ended.

employer_sponsored.description: Whether the applicant is sponsored by an employer.

in_australia_at_application.description: Whether the applicant is physically in Australia when the application is lodged.

has_health_insurance.description: Whether the applicant holds current health insurance covering them in Australia.

genuine_temporary_entrant.description: Whether the applicant is a genuine temporary entrant (the genuine temporary entrant test).
